remarks: Don't miss this totally renovated chic studio apartment with HEATED GARAGE SPACE in downtown Stamford. Heat, Hot Water and Cooking Gas is included in rent. Newer Kitchen with granite countertops, tile floor and gas range. Bright and airy apartment with new hardwood floors, freshly painted and newly renovated bathroom. Lots of closets and storage in basement. Don't miss the private balcony overlooking Summer Street. Building has laundry room in the lower level along with a fitness center and renovated courtyard. Tenant responsible for Credit Check and $250 Move in/Move Out Charge
